theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_sch_ube_rescaled_structure
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Φ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (w : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (y₀ : Rn n) (ρ α lam M : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ‖y₀‖ + ρ ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ α → 0 ≤ M → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, lam * ‖P‖ ^ 2 ≤ a x P P) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |a x P Q| ≤ M * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |a x P Q - a y P Q| ≤ M * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |Φ x P - Φ y P| ≤ M * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖w x‖ ≤ M) → (∀ z ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, lam * ‖P‖ ^ 2 ≤ a (y₀ + ρ • z) P P) ∧ (∀ z ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |a (y₀ + ρ • z) P Q| ≤ M * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) ∧ (∀ z ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ z' ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |a (y₀ + ρ • z) P Q - a (y₀ + ρ • z') P Q| ≤ M * ‖z - z'‖ ^ α * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) ∧ (∀ z ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ z' ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |(ρ • Φ (y₀ + ρ • z)) P - (ρ • Φ (y₀ + ρ • z')) P| ≤ M * ‖z - z'‖ ^ α * ‖P‖) ∧ ∀ z ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖w (y₀ + ρ • z)‖ ≤ M
